selection: highest mean episode_reward, then lowest mean avg_waiting_time, then candidate id
tuning_aggregation: equal weight per tuning case; random 8/20; explicit scenarios 2/20 each
test_aggregation: equal weight per declared traffic case; random 30/60; explicit scenarios 5/60 each

bootstrap.unit: paired scenario/traffic seed, stratified by scenario
bootstrap.ci_scope: traffic variation conditional on the three frozen checkpoints; not retraining uncertainty
bootstrap.dqn: average three independent model runs per traffic case before resampling; not an executable ensemble
